about: PAD-1031: co-op characters (PAD-1075: DoomWalrus666's list) for Godzilla (Pro and Premium/LE). Each teammate picks one at the start of their first ball; no two teammates have the same one; RANDOM picks one nobody has. Each ability holds while its teammate is up. Pictures are your own files: add them in the Modes tab's Characters dialog.
